title: Choose the visual world for Veloura
question: The roll assigned The Appointment Card. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Palette, fonts and the forest 3D hero stay fixed in every option.

options.label: The Appointment Card
options.lineage: five-star hotel concierge appointment cards and reception desks in Makati and BGC
options.thesis: The whole site is a concierge writing your consultation onto a card, and every page ends with that card in your hand.
options.viewport: Deep forest field with the 3D sculpture on the right half; on the left the headline and a live ivory appointment card (treatment, branch, day, time slots) you can start filling in the hero.
options.risk: If the card motif is only decoration and not the real booking control, it reads as a gimmick.

raised.raise: The hero commits to one light source: forest field lit only by the sculpture's champagne glow, no scattered accents.
Booking progress is a persistent rail of punched marks; state is a mark (punched, stamped), never just a colour change.
Locations become a live line of three branches with each clinic's open or closed state from Manila time.
Your card remembers what you picked and follows you from page to page until you book.
Time slots and prices set as giant display numerals that outrank the body text.

options.label: The Consultation Map
options.lineage: dermatologist facial zone maps and skin analysis reports
options.thesis: The site reads like a personal skin assessment: treatments are placed on a facial zone map, with measured annotations and a plan that builds as you explore.
options.viewport: Forest hero with the sculpture; below, an interactive face-zone diagram where tapping forehead, cheeks or jawline reveals matching treatments.
options.risk: The most familiar direction for skin clinics, and a diagram can feel clinical instead of inviting.

options.label: Indoor Weather Sun
options.lineage: installation art: an indoor sun in a hazed hall
options.thesis: One vast amber light field with visitors as silhouettes.
options.viewport: A half sun on a far wall doubled by a mirrored ceiling.
options.case: Fuses poorly: amber monochrome breaks the pinned forest and ivory palette and says nothing about treatments.
options.kept: Total commitment to one light source in the hero.

options.label: Cutting Bench Rail
options.thesis: Sections strung along a perforated rail like frames.
options.viewport: A perforated strip crossing an orange field.
options.case: Fuses poorly: patients do not identify with film editing, and orange on black fights the brand.
options.risk: Industrial where the brand is calm.
options.kept: State shown as a mark, and a persistent progress rail.

options.label: Sleeping City Fold
options.thesis: Districts fold like quilts under one night sky.
options.viewport: A night city creasing into a blanket.
options.case: Fuses poorly: whimsical night world, loses clinical trust.
options.kept: Branches as a real spatial line with live local state.

options.label: Minihompy Room
options.thesis: Identity as a room you furnish.
options.viewport: An isometric pastel room with a visitor counter.
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful pastel is the overly pink beauty look the brief rules out.
options.kept: Visitor choices persist across the visit.

options.label: Illuminated Initial
options.thesis: One giant letter grows into a gold margin of scenes.
options.viewport: A giant historiated initial beside three lines of text.
options.case: Fuses poorly: ornate and historical, the opposite of modern clinical care.
options.kept: One giant typographic element that outranks everything.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What premium aesthetic clinics ship: calm beige site, model portrait hero, treatment grid, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Full-bleed portrait of a model with glowing skin, headline and booking button over it.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other clinic by design.
